python -c "
import re
# Test with different patterns
p = r'[+-]?\d+\.\d+|\d*\.\d+'
m = re.match(p, '-.121')
print('Test 1:', m)

p = r'[+-]?\d+\.\d+|[-+]?\d*\.\d+'
m = re.match(p, '-.121')
print('Test 2:', m)
"

raw_message.reasoning:
